constraints.impact: Answering every query by adding numbers from scratch is O(m · n) ≈ 10⁶ and passes. Sort + prefix array + binary search is O(n log n + m log n): the way to go when there are many queries.
The sum of all numbers is at most 1000 · 10⁶ = 10⁹ < 2³¹ − 1, so int is enough for pre. Positive numbers make pre strictly increasing, so binary search on it works.

constraints.text: subsequence: delete some elements, keep the order (statement)
constraints.meaning: Any set of elements can be chosen; only its size and sum matter.
constraints.impact: To fit as many numbers as possible under a sum, take the smallest ones. So sorting nums first does not change the answer.

bruteForce.summary: sort nums once. For every query, add the smallest numbers one by one until the next one does not fit. Each query walks up to n numbers again: O(m · n).
